test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025: Morning Practice Day 2
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 479 152 937 512 738 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right. 

If all the numbers are arranged in ascending order, the position(s) of how many numbers will remain unchanged?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 479 152 937 512 738 (Right)

According to the question, all the numbers of the given series are arranged in ascending order:

 
 

 **Given numbers**
 479
 152
 937
 512
 738
 
 

 All the numbers arranged in ascending order
 152
 479
 512
 738
 937
 
 

 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, none of the positions of the numbers will remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
